messages:
zoe (PM): Putting up the GA acceptance checklist for the inference product. We need explicit owners for SLA wording, monitoring alerts, runbooks, pricing footnotes, and legal language. Can we confirm owners and blockers?

omar (SRE): I looked through the draft. Two items to resolve before GA: (1) final SLO numbers for hosted vs dedicated, (2) a documented fallback routing policy when a model variant breaches error budget.

lina (Product): Product is ok to accept slightly degraded p99s for long-context models if we document behavior and show measured tradeoffs. Also need a shortline for sales to use about Dedicated SLAs.

raj (Sales): Sales requests a minimal public promise for Dedicated: "contractual SLA available" plus a clear process for credits. We also want an interim one-liner for prospects.

claire (Docs): I'll own the GA docs + runbook. Need the exact alert expressions and escalation steps (pages, severity, runbook links) from SRE so I can include them verbatim. ETA: draft by Fri.

omar (SRE): Suggested SLOs to review:
```yaml
hosted:
  availability: "99.95%"
  latency_p99: "<=350ms"
dedicated:
  availability: "99.9%"
  latency_p99: "<=500ms (depends on model)"
private:
  availability: "contractual"
  latency: "best-effort, monitored"
```
Will add an error-budget policy: automatic degraded routing + reserve pool spillover when budget burned >50% in 1h.

zoe (PM): That split looks fine. Who will own the credit calculation (for downtime credits) and the wording?

raj (Sales): I can draft the customer-facing sentence and an internal formula, but legal needs to sign off on the credit calc.

legal-bot: Reminder: include the credit cap (max credits per month) and an exclusion clause for force majeure. Legal review required for any SLA promise.

omar (SRE): For alerting/oncall flow I propose:
1) model_error_rate_high -> page SRE primary (sev2)
2) pct_failed_requests_by_model > 5% over 5m -> page oncall (sev1) + tag product/ML
3) if model-quality drift detected by eval harness (automated regression) -> page product + ML (sev1)
I'll paste promql examples into the runbook.

claire (Docs): Please paste the promql snippets. Also include example triage steps (how to rollback to previous model revision, how to enable fallback) — I need the exact CLI or API snippet.

omar (SRE): Example alert (placeholder):
```promql
(sum(rate(model_response_error_total[5m])) by (model) / sum(rate(model_requests_total[5m])) by (model)) > 0.05
```
And an automated policy: when error_budget_burned_percent > 50 and sustained > 10m -> traffic_shift{policy="fallback"}.

lina (Product): For launch criteria Product will sign off on GA provided: docs published (public + internal runbook), oncall rota filled for GA week, SLOs documented, and a provisional pricing page (with footnote for Dedicated/private). Premium SLA lane can be post-GA gated.

raj (Sales): OK. For customer comms we need one-liner: "Dedicated deployments include contractual SLAs; pricing & premium SLAs available via negotiation." That will buy us time.

zoe (PM): Action items and owners:
- omar: finalize SLO doc + include promql alert rules (owner) — due Thu EOD (1844520000)
- claire: publish GA readiness doc + runbook draft with embedded alerts & CLI snippets — due Fri (1844606400)
- raj: draft customer-facing SLA sentence + internal credit calc proposal — due Mon (1844692800)
- lina: decision on gating premium SLA (post-GA or pilot) — due Mon (1844692800)
- oncall-rotation: confirm GA-week rota and escalation handoff — due Thu (1844520000)

omar (SRE): I'll also add a traffic steering test in staging so we can rehearse fallback during burnin.

claire (Docs): Once I have the runbook draft I'll post to #eng-oncall for review.

oncall-rotation: Rota confirmed for GA week; primary/secondary assigned.

zoe (PM): Please add any blockers to the acceptance sheet (https://intra.redwood/ga-acceptance). If no major objections by Thu EOD we'll mark as "Ready for greenlight" and schedule the readout.

omar (SRE): ack.

lina (Product): ack.

raj (Sales): ack.

claire (Docs): ack.
